When your opponent's king moves to an edge or corner, look for checks that force it into even worse positions. Here Black's king on f8 is driven to f7, then mated by the rook on the 7th rank—a classic pattern. The Queen check pulls the king into the rook's attack. Watch for back-rank and 7th-rank mating patterns when the enemy king is trapped.
